subject: Orbit cutover: sanity validation and runbook acceptance
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Cc: operations@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Orbit cutover: pre-flight checklist & acceptance criteria

Team —

We're T-48h from the PioneerHealth private deployment switch (Orbit). I attached the runbook draft (orbit_runbook_v3.pdf) and the initial ACL CSV we got from NetBridge. High level asks before we move into the activation window: 

- Finalize smoke test owners (see table page 2).
- Confirm KV-cache priming window and script owner (we need a responsible engineer for the script run and validation).
- Validate BGP session failover steps with NetBridge and confirm community tags.
- Confirm telemetry retention toggle for 72h post-cutover to capture sample traces.

Please reply with owners and any objections by EOD tomorrow. I'll consolidate and send the bridge invite.

Irene
Irene Choi
Sr. PM, Private Deployments | Redwood Inference

Attachments: orbit_runbook_v3.pdf (37KB), network-acls.csv (4KB)
From: Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@pioneerhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orbit cutover: pre-flight checklist & acceptance criteria

Thanks, Irene —

We reviewed the runbook internally. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

1) During KV priming, can we throttle traffic to the legacy inference cluster for 15 minutes to keep error telemetry low?
2) Procurement needs the finalized SOW and the DocuSign link before Friday for budget signoff.
3) NetBridge has requested a dedicated maintenance IP range to be opened for their collectors.

Carlos Mendes
Head of Cloud Ops | PioneerHealth
Procurement: procurement@pioneerhealth.com

On a process note: can PioneerHealth have a named on-call for the first 24 hours post-cutover? We'll coordinate on rotation if so.
From: Nayla Ortiz <nayla@netbridge.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-03T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orbit cutover: pre-flight checklist & acceptance criteria

Hi all —

NetBridge confirms BGP community tags and the maintenance IP range. I attached our collector IPs in the network-acls.csv. We'll be ready to validate flows during the warmup window. A few notes: 

- Our recommended sequence: (1) open maintenance range, (2) verify traceroutes from NetBridge collectors, (3) provider-level BGP withdraw test, (4) re-announce and validate path.
- We'll be on the bridge for the entire 3-hr window and can run a quick withdraw test at minute 45 if you want an early failover validation.

Nayla Ortiz
Technical Account Lead | NetBridge Solutions
Attachments: network-acls.csv (duplicate for clarity)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, Nayla Ortiz <nayla@netbridge.io>, Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@pioneerhealth.com>
Date: 2027-10-04T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orbit cutover: pre-flight checklist & acceptance criteria

Acknowledged. Owners assigned below: 

- Smoke test lead (end-to-end generation + latency): Vivek Kulkarni
- KV-cache priming script owner & validation: Karthik Iyer
- ACL and routing validation with NetBridge: Monica Patel (comms lead)
- Telemetry retention/retrospective traces: Marissa Cole (ops)

Planned verification steps for KV priming (short): 
1) Run kv_cache_priming_script.sh in a canary namespace, populate prefix keys for 2 popular models.
2) Run 100 synthetic inference requests against canary until cache hit-rate > 85%.
3) Snapshot latency percentiles and push to shared Drive folder.
4) If hit-rate < 70% after 10 minutes, abort and roll back to warmup step.

I've uploaded the priming script to the Drive folder and added an execution checklist. Will start a dry run tomorrow 03:00 UTC.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Eng Manager, Private Deployments | Redwood Inference
Attachments: kv_cache_priming_script.sh (1.2KB)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, Nayla Ortiz <nayla@netbridge.io>, Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@pioneerhealth.com>
Date: 2027-10-05T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orbit cutover: pre-flight checklist & acceptance criteria

All — quick technical updates from the KV/smoke side after the dry run overnight: 

- KV priming dry run completed against canary cluster (logs in Drive). Hit-rate reached 88% after ~7 minutes for the two sample models.
- Synthetic latency p95 with primed cache: 110ms; without priming baseline p95: 380ms.
- Observed one replication lag on node-node link during priming (tracked as INC-ORBIT-21). We increased write buffers and the lag dropped below threshold.
- Recommendation: run full priming 30 minutes before traffic cutover, and keep the 15-minute throttled-window Carlos requested to reduce noisy errors.

I'll be on the activation bridge at T-30m and will own smoke sign-off.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior SRE | Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, Nayla Ortiz <nayla@netbridge.io>, Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@pioneerhealth.com>, procurement@pioneerhealth.com
Date: 2027-10-05T17:40:00-07:00
Subject: Orbit cutover: bridge notes, DocuSign & go/no-go cadence

Thanks everyone — good progress. Final housekeeping before we close the loop: 

- DocuSign SOW: Carlos/procurement, link sent (related_links). Please complete signatures by EOD Friday to avoid schedule slippage.
- Bridge plan: 3-hour maintenance window, engineering bridge will open 20 minutes prior. We will run KV priming at T-30m then start staged traffic shift.
- Go/no-go cadence: 
  * T-60m: final checklist review (Irene)
  * T-30m: KV priming start (Karthik)
  * T-10m: telemetry retention toggle to 72h (Marissa)
  * T+5m: smoke validation (Vivek) — pass/fail posted to bridge
  * T+30m: partial rollback decision point (if >2% error increase vs baseline)

Contingency: If KV priming fails or the replication lag reappears, we will halt and run a rollback procedure documented in orbit_runbook_v3.pdf (section 6). Monica, please confirm NetBridge collectors will delay synthetic sampling during T+0..+15 to avoid skewed metrics.

If there are no objections I will mark the runbook accepted and send the bridge invite.

Irene
Irene Choi
Sr. PM, Private Deployments | Redwood Inference

Onward — let's keep notes tight in the bridge and capture every sign-off in the ticket (OPS-4551).
